rule: Each prompt is an obvious, feel-safe first framing. The run must name and kill that framing, emit the six report headings (or the suspect variant), and must not emit a product, stack, or feature list before sharpening.

evals.prompt: AI for X: an AI dashboard for warehouse managers to cut waste.
Hackathon idea: Uber for leftover food delivery.
A marketplace that connects farmers directly to consumers.
An app that teaches market women financial literacy.
Cold storage as a service for African markets. That's the whole product.
ChatGPT for HR. We just need to wrap a model around onboarding docs.
A super-app that connects patients, doctors, pharmacies, and insurers.
evals.reject: super-app that connects two (or more) sides

evals.prompt: Analytics for SMEs so owners finally see their numbers.
AI tutor that makes anyone a better founder in 30 days.
Empowerment platform for women in supply chains. Inclusion is the moat.
